inspect-aws.--exclude-region: Regions to exclude. Include multiple times if more than one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 (accepts multiple inputs)
inspect-aws.--exclude-resource-type: Resource types to exclude from inspection. Include multiple times if more than one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          (accepts multiple inputs)
inspect-aws.--include-tag: Only include resources with this tag (format: key=value). Key matching is exact (case-sensitive). Value is a case-sensitive regex that performs partial matching (use ^value$ for exact match, or (?i)value for case-insensitive). Each key may only appear once. Include multiple times for AND logic. Example: --include-tag "env=^prod$"  (accepts multiple inputs)
inspect-aws.--list-unaliased-kms-keys: List KMS keys that do not have aliases associated with them. (default: false)
inspect-aws.--newer-than: Only delete resources newer than this specified value. Can be any valid Go duration, such as 10m or 8h. (default: "0s")
inspect-aws.--older-than: Only delete resources older than this specified value. Can be any valid Go duration, such as 10m or 8h. (default: "0s")
inspect-aws.--output-file: Write output to file instead of stdout (optional)
inspect-aws.--region: Regions to include. Include multiple times if more than one.         (accepts multiple inputs)
inspect-aws.--resource-type: Resource types to inspect. Include multiple times if more than one.  (accepts multiple inputs)
